evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce IndustrialKnowEval (IndKnow), a benchmark for industrial knowledge and engineering question answering.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for industrial tasks, yet few benchmarks evaluate their mastery of industrial knowledge across different types of cognitive demand.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Building upon IndKnow, we propose the Industrial Cognitive Capability Gap (ICCG) metric to characterize the performance differential between foundational industrial knowledge and higher-order reasoning and application, and we analyze it alongside absolute performance to provide a more complete view of model capabilities.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: It contains 43,282 samples covering 21 task types across seven industrial sectors, including aerospace, electric power, and metallurgy, organized into four levels of cognitive demand: memory, comprehension, reasoning, and engineering application.
